title: Drawn instruments (our own)
description: Original instruments as control points and parameters, no audio: wavetable instruments (bass guitar, electric guitar, viola, cello, choir pad), a computed drum kit (kick, snare, closed and open hat, clap, tom), a Karplus-Strong steel guitar pluck, FM percussion, and three synthetic room presets, with seeded variants. Wavetables and one-shots are built in the page when a program names a wt_drawn_* or dr_* sound. CC0-1.0.

ingredients.title: Drawn bass and choir pad
ingredients.description: control points and parameters; wavetables built in memory on first use

ingredients.title: Computed drum kit
ingredients.description: six drum models as parameter sets, four seeded variants each; one-shots built in memory on first use

ingredients.title: Steel guitar, FM percussion, synthetic spaces
ingredients.description: a Karplus-Strong pluck per note, three FM percussion voices (4 seeded variants each), and three room presets (reverb controls, no audio)
